description:
This page is about a music movement. For the aesthetic based on the maid uniform, see Maid .

Maidcore (Мейдкор) is an internet music scene and aesthetic that originated in the mid-2010s within the Russian social media platform VK. The movement is defined by a community of anonymous musicians who adopt the personas of the "Nijiura Maids," a set of fictional characters created on the Japanese imageboard Futaba Channel (2chan). [ 1 ] The core of the aesthetic is this act of performance: artists release their music under the pseudonym of a specific maid (e.g., "Yakui the Maid," "Ozoi the Maid"), and the music itself is intended to be an instrumental expression of that character's personality and backstory.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Anonymity, emotional expression (depressive-aggressive), experimentation, online community
